statement: You receive a row of integers. Rearrange it into ascending order and print the result. Build the answer the selection way: repeatedly find the smallest value in the part that is still unsorted and swap it to the front border. Print the sorted values on one line, separated by single spaces.

example.why: Pass by pass the minimum of the unsorted part moves to the border: 11 first, then 12, then 22.

hint: Track the index of the smallest value seen in the pass, and swap once after the pass ends.
mistake: Swapping inside the scan every time a smaller value appears - that shuffles the row; select first, swap once.
